good_night.description: Run the good night routine: turn off TV and lights, close and lock the door, set heat to 18.
good_night.code:
def good_night():
    switch("tv", "off")
    switch("lights", "off")
    switch("door", "closed")
    switch("lock", "locked")
    while heat() > 18:
        cooler()
    return "Turned off the TV and lights, closed and locked the door, and set the heat to 18 degrees."

movie_time.description: Turns on the TV and turns off the lights for movie time.
movie_time.code:
def movie_time():
    switch("tv", "on")
    switch("lights", "off")
    return "Turned the TV on and the lights off."

good_morning.description: Run the good morning routine: lights on, unlock door, heat to 21.
